sam: Quick pitch: reduce long-tail open items after postmortems with a short lifecycle and ownership signals. Trying a minimal pilot.

sam: Proposed lifecycle (minimal):
- T+0: IC assigned, impact tags added, quick triage note in thread
- T+48: remediation card created (if not resolved) with owner + ETA
- T+7d: sprint snapshot posted in-thread (owner updates status)
- T+21d: verify via test/metric and close or replan
- T+60d: recurrence check if flagged

rachael: Nice and tight. Request: make ETA mandatory at T+48 and require a verification metric. Too many vague actions.

priya: ops-bot can enforce: create a tracker card at T+48 for P1/P2 threads, require ETA and verification field. I can wire that.

ops-bot: scheduled_reminder created -> "T+48 create-remediation-card" for thread 2355556666.

alexc: IC rotation tweak: 2-week IC window, one-week shadow overlap before the handoff. Shadow must read last 3 incident threads and confirm OK. Keeps continuity.

sam: For recurring patterns: if same service has 3 incidents with same symptom tag in 45d, auto-tag for a 30m pattern review and invite owners.

rachael: Agreed. Keep the pattern review short and focused: hypothesis + one short mitigation to deploy within 7 days. Invite product/CS for customer-impacting ones.

priya: I'll add the recurrence rule to the tracker webhook and have ops-bot post the card link in-thread when created. Also configure weekly pings to owners until done.

alexc: I'll update the runbook language for ETA enforcement and the IC/shadow flow.

sam: Can owners drop a one-line ack here so ops-bot can auto-assign the card?

rachael: ack — will own verification metric guidance.

priya: ack — wiring tracker and reminders.

alexc: ack — runbook update tomorrow.

ops-bot: reminder closed -> "T+48 create-remediation-card" for thread 2355556666.
